venture.name: Outfit Hanger
venture.concept: One hanger for a complete outfit.
venture.product: A hanger with areas for a shirt, pants, socks, and accessories.
venture.customers: Teens and adults, parents of young children, workers, and students with busy routines.
venture.valueProposition: Keep the pieces of an outfit together to make getting ready faster and more organized.
venture.market: North America (competitor price observations are US listings).
venture.distribution: Not specified in research. The laboratory models a direct-to-consumer online store as an editable operating scenario.
venture.revenueModel: Not specified. One-time per-hanger sale is the modeled scenario, based on the physical-product concept; not confirmed by an operating business.

products.name: Outfit Hanger
products.description: One hanger designed to hold a complete outfit together. Final materials, construction, dimensions, and manufacturing process are not confirmed.

offers.notes: Four clear zip pockets; one back pocket. Shipping and taxes not determined.
$43 per organizer; $10 less than five singles at listed prices.
Online minimum order two; no accessory pockets described.
Different form and capacity from a single hanger; not in comparable-item statistics.

offers.product: 4 Shelf Hanging Fabric Storage Organizer with Hang Bar
offers.notes: Different form and footprint; not in comparable-item statistics.

competitors.basis: Comparable statistics use only P01 and P03, both individual hanging items. They differ in functionality. Research checked October 27, 2026; listed prices are snapshots, not live prices.

sources.name: Shopify US pricing — Basic plan
sources.detail: Official pricing page listed $39/month billed monthly and $29/month billed yearly for Basic, and standard online card rates of 2.9% + $0.30. Model uses the monthly plan and standard rate; actual checkout quote, region and payment setup may differ.

sources.name: Stripe US pricing
sources.detail: Official US pricing page lists 2.9% + $0.30 for standard domestic online card transactions. Model uses this only as a reference; actual processor and transaction mix are unknown.

sources.name: BLS May 2025 OEWS — Assemblers and Fabricators
sources.detail: BLS reports a $22.19 median hourly wage for team assemblers in manufacturing (May 2025). The $0.37 per-unit labor reference assumes one minute of direct assembly and is a derived illustration, not a supplier quote.

sources.name: USPS Notice 123 — Ground Advantage Retail
sources.detail: Notice 123 effective October 4, 2026 lists $11.70 for a 1 lb retail parcel in Zone 5. Product weight, dimensions, zone, commercial discounts and seller-paid shipping are unknown; model starts disabled.

sources.name: US Small Business Administration — Launch your business
sources.detail: SBA identifies product liability insurance as relevant to businesses that manufacture, wholesale, distribute, or retail products. The model's premium amount is illustrative and requires an insurance quote.

sources.name: IRS Instructions for Form 4562 — Startup and organizational costs
sources.detail: IRS describes an election for certain startup/organizational costs and 180-month amortization of remaining eligible amounts. The dashboard keeps startup cash separate and offers explicit optional amortization; it is not tax advice.

costs.name: Prototype and design iteration
costs.description: Samples and design revisions to prove the multi-garment layout and accessory areas.
costs.assumptions: Planning placeholder only. Obtain prototype-maker quotes after dimensions and material are chosen.

costs.name: Business registration and setup
costs.description: State filing, basic bookkeeping setup, and launch administration.
costs.assumptions: State and entity type are unknown. Check state filing fees and professional advice before use.

costs.name: Packaging design and drop-test samples
costs.description: Initial package mockups and handling tests for a hanger-shaped item.
costs.assumptions: Placeholder for a small sample run. Packaging dimensions and fragility are unknown.

costs.name: Production tooling or mold
costs.description: Potential one-time tooling if the final design needs a custom mold or production fixture.
costs.assumptions: Disabled because material and process are unknown. Supplier quotes may range widely; never treat this placeholder as an industry benchmark.

costs.name: Online store subscription
costs.description: Optional hosted checkout and inventory listing for a direct-to-consumer sales scenario.
costs.reference: Shopify Basic: $39/month billed monthly, US pricing page checked 2026-10-27.
costs.assumptions: DTC ecommerce is not specified in the research. Model assumes Shopify Basic on monthly billing; verify region, plan and current pricing.

costs.name: Domain renewal allocation
costs.description: Annual domain registration allocation for an independent storefront.
costs.assumptions: The existing website may use a free GitHub Pages address. This is an optional custom-domain allowance, not a quoted registrar price.

costs.name: Product liability insurance allowance
costs.description: Potential coverage for a product business; actual eligibility and premiums require an insurer quote.
costs.reference: SBA identifies product liability coverage as relevant to product manufacturers, distributors and retailers; no premium benchmark supplied.
costs.assumptions: Placeholder premium only. Obtain a quote based on product design, sales and coverage limits.

costs.name: Marketing and creative tests
costs.description: Small launch experiments, product photography, and promotional materials.
costs.assumptions: Scenario allowance, not a cost benchmark or customer-acquisition forecast. No demand lift is assumed.

costs.name: Home storage and handling allowance
costs.description: Small home-based inventory and packing-space allowance; no commercial lease assumed.
costs.assumptions: Optional home space allocation. No warehouse or office is assumed.

costs.name: Bookkeeping and tax support
costs.description: Basic bookkeeping software or limited outside support.
costs.assumptions: Placeholder only. Actual software choice, business structure and professional fees are unknown.

costs.name: Founder labor allowance
costs.description: Optional value for founder time spent assembling, packing, and supporting customers.
costs.assumptions: Starts disabled and at $0 because owner compensation and time are unknown. Enter a monthly target if desired.

costs.name: Hanger body, pockets, and components
costs.description: Per-unit outsourced materials and production allowance for the hanger and garment/accessory sections.
costs.assumptions: No bill of materials or supplier quote exists. Placeholder only; varies materially with material, process, order quantity and quality.

costs.name: Direct assembly labor
costs.description: Estimated hands-on time to add the pants, sock, and accessory areas and inspect one item.
costs.reference: Derived from BLS team-assembler median $22.19/hour × one minute ÷ 60 = $0.37 per unit.
costs.assumptions: One minute per unit is an unverified time assumption; does not include payroll burden, minimum labor batches, waste or indirect labor.

costs.name: Per-unit retail packaging
costs.description: Individual package, insert, and protection around each hanger.
costs.assumptions: Package size/material are unknown. Obtain packaging quotations and test parcel dimensions.

costs.name: Inbound freight allocation
costs.description: Estimated per-unit share of shipping finished goods from a supplier to the fulfillment location.
costs.assumptions: No factory, order size, freight lane, customs cost or quote is available. North American import duties are not modeled.

costs.name: Online card processing percentage
costs.description: Percentage portion of a standard domestic online card processing fee.
costs.reference: Shopify/Stripe US standard online domestic card rate: 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction, checked 2026-10-27.
costs.assumptions: Assumes domestic online card transactions on a selected provider. Does not include international cards, chargebacks, alternate wallets or third-party plan fees.

costs.name: Online card processing fixed fee
costs.description: Fixed component of the online card processing charge per transaction.
costs.reference: Shopify/Stripe US standard online domestic card rate includes $0.30 per transaction, checked 2026-10-27.
costs.assumptions: Assumes one payment transaction per unit sold. Bundles and multi-unit orders change the fee allocation.

costs.name: Seller-paid outbound postage
costs.description: Optional postage allowance when the venture pays delivery instead of charging the customer separately.
costs.reference: USPS Ground Advantage retail: $11.70 for a 1 lb Zone 5 parcel (Notice 123 effective 2026-10-04).
costs.assumptions: One-pound and Zone 5 planning point only. The hanger may be oversized/dimensional, heavier, shipped to other zones, or priced on a commercial account. Seller-paid shipping starts disabled.

costs.name: Returns and replacement allowance
costs.description: Per-order reserve for damaged items, replacements, and return handling.
costs.assumptions: Placeholder; no return policy, defect rate, or return data exists. Do not treat as an observed rate.

scenarios.name: Lean startup
scenarios.note: Illustrative: reduced shared overhead and 40% of base sales volume; does not model an expected outcome.

scenarios.name: Typical operation
scenarios.note: Illustrative baseline: current expense settings and student-entered sales quantity.

scenarios.name: Expansion
scenarios.note: Illustrative capacity scenario: 1.5× shared fixed overhead and 2.5× volume, independently assumed. Higher spend is not assumed to cause higher sales.

limitations: Venture construction, product dimensions, materials, suppliers, minimum order quantities, fulfillment channel, and actual costs are not documented.
The website is a concept/marketing page; it does not confirm a live checkout, sales history, or revenue model.
All unquoted production, packaging, registration, insurance, marketing, bookkeeping, and sales-volume values are illustrative editable assumptions.
Research prices for competitors were checked October 27, 2026 and may have changed; they are not live price feeds.
Comparable competitor summary uses only the individual Hanger Valet ($45) and IKEA hanger ($13.99); functionality differs and the sample is too small to represent the market.
Tax, duties, sales tax remittance, financing, owner draw, income tax, returns, chargebacks, and international fulfillment are not included unless added by the student.
Break-even assumes constant selling price, constant variable cost per unit, fixed costs over the selected monthly horizon, and the student's sales mix; real demand and costs can vary.
The model is an educational scenario tool, not tax, legal, insurance, accounting, or investment advice.
